searchLog: Read life/PIPELINE.md, life/PROFILE.md, life/OUTLOOK.md §5, morning-briefing/profile.md, data/target-companies.json, history/sent-log.json (last 190 opportunity entries), and data/applications.json to build an exclusion list — Dom has already applied to or been rejected from most frontier/big-tech names on the target list (Stripe x2, IBM x6, Tesla, Figma, McKinsey, Robert Half, Retell AI, Y Combinator, Red Ventures, Ford, CarMax, Kalshi, Goldman, TikTok, Mathematica, Veeva, Claude Corps, Disney, Notion BDR, CIL, Enova, Graviton, LSEG, Micron, InstaLILY, Northslope, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Simon-Kucher, IMC, Point72/Cubist). Note: the graduation-date conflict flagged in the hunt brief appears already resolved — life/PROFILE.md shows December 2026 'SETTLED by Dom 2026-08-04,' matching morning-briefing/profile.md; no live conflict to reconcile this run. Picked Sierra (APX), Glean, Ramp, Cohere, Databricks, Nvidia, Scale AI, Notion (non-BDR roles), Meta RPM, Google/DeepMind APM, OpenAI Emerging Talent, and YC Startup School / HBS SVMP-tier programs as the rotation, none of which appear in the sent-log exclusion list. Could not verify any of them: WebFetch failed DNS resolution under this session's network policy for every host tried except anthropic.com — boards-api.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com, sierra.ai, scale.com, ramp.com, www.databricks.com, www.nvidia.com, www.notion.com, www.metacareers.com, www.google.com, openai.com, www.ycombinator.com, and www.hbs.edu all returned ENOTFOUND. This matches the prior run's log (2026-11-24), so the block is session-policy-level and recurring, not a one-off. The one host that resolved, anthropic.com/careers/jobs, showed only Fellows Program (research-only, no new-grad pipeline per target-companies.json), Business Development Representative (SF/NYC — ambiguous whether distinct from the 'Business Development Representative, New York' title already in sent-log, so not safe to treat as new), Research Associate Biology, and Product Support Specialist (Tokyo/Sydney) — nothing new, verified, and eligible. Per the standing rule, zero verified opportunities is the honest result; nothing is included on the strength of a WebSearch snippet alone since the verification step (actually fetching the live page) could not run for any candidate.
